author: vulnpocalypse
text: A jailbroken AI agent attacked a European telecom and 13 hosted organizations for two weeks; patch Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 now.

author: TechRadarPro
text: 'We are not giving up': Russian hosting giant Beget has cloud platform wiped in major cyberattack

author: vulnpocalypse
text: Android November 2026 update fixes critical zero-click RCE CVE-2026-58868 in Framework

author: vulnpocalypse
text: Critical BeyondTrust Remote Support flaw CVE-2026-102764 (CVSS 9.3) was exploited as a zero-day by Armory Castle and is now in CISA KEV; patch and hunt.

author: TanmayK_03
text: New CVE-2026-77604 in Code Graph RAG's MCP server (fixed in 0.0.345): read_file skipped its path check when offset or limit was set, allowing reads outside the root via absolute paths.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: REPORT: Wiz, Sentra and Mandiant say an actor used Qubole-associated AWS credentials from 14-26 Oct to assume customer roles, read secrets and copy S3 data. No Qubole notice yet.

author: coinspect
text: Another supply-chain attack: compromised bee-js and Swarm Desktop releases steal wallet keys and install persistent backdoors. The npm package had valid provenance; the official release workflow published malicious code.

author: ernesttheaiguy
text: A Paint RCE (CVE-2026-83844) patched only through the Microsoft Store, not Windows Update. The advisory says 11.2609.401.0 is fixed, but the CVE record still lists anything below 11.2605.91.0 as affected.

author: Xiba_AI
text: A 9.5 RCE in React Server Components has no CVE, so CVE feeds never show it. Fixed in react-server-dom 19.0.9+.

author: zeroSteiner
text: Three new exploits in the VulnCheck initial access feed this week: GitLab CI/CD unauth RCE, a pre-auth Atlassian Data Center file read, and a Collabora command injection, each a go-exploit module with detection.

author: Digital_Warfare
text: Plex2Shell: 4 CVEs enable unauthenticated RCE on QNAP NAS: CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, CVE-2026-96656

author: cvedotnow
text: CRITICAL 9.4 pyLoad: device node creation via tar extraction (CVE-2026-123815). A low-privilege user can upload a crafted archive that creates device nodes or named pipes on the host. Fix: 0.5.0b3.dev102

author: kkaasolutions
text: CVE-2026-124079 (CRITICAL / 9.8) rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.19 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.1 contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability.

author: aegiryy
text: 100+ Chrome CVEs by a single researcher would've been unimaginable in the pre-LLM era. What a year for AI-driven vulnerability research.

author: WoldLabs
text: CISA added OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158 ("SSHole") to KEV today: password authentication bypass in sshd on Linux with musl libc and no PAM, like Alpine's default openssh-server. Federal due date: Nov 12.

author: int_csm
text: Japanese homeware giant pulls online store after cloud breach puts 7.7M records at risk

author: fourweekmba
text: Nvidia-backed Fireworks AI, valued at $17.5B, was hacked again 18 days after its first breach. Oct 6: unauthorized use of internal credentials. Oct 24: an intruder reached dev machines via a cloud provider. Nov 9: billing data and some model data hit, it says.

author: AGTPinsights
text: BREAKING: Nvidia-backed Fireworks AI told customers of a second hack in weeks, with an Oct. 24 breach at a cloud provider exposing customer data.

author: Shalev_lif
text: Frontier AI labs are not the only targets for model theft. Fireworks has been hacked, and customer model weights have been leaked.

author: fireball_triada
text: AgentScope CVE-2026-123022: command injection via the MCP workspace API, through 2.0.11. Exploit public; still unfixed as of 10 Nov. Reporter: no auth needed. Keep that endpoint off the network until a fix ships.

author: theagenticdaily
text: A single crafted link could trick Atlassian's Rovo AI agent into leaking private Confluence, Jira, and SharePoint data to an attacker. Researchers at DEF CON showed a URL parameter could seed hidden instructions that made the agent browse out sensitive data; Atlassian paid a bug bounty.

author: marc_david
text: German web host Mittwald built an MCP server to let customers' AI assistants manage their hosting accounts. Mittwald says an attacker exploited a flaw in it, read session tokens of the customers who used it, and compromised 56 customer projects.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Attackers abused Qubole's trusted AWS IAM role chain to breach multiple customer accounts between Oct 14-26, harvesting secrets from Lambda, Secrets Manager, SSM, and S3 at scale.

author: DeFiMktJournal
text: Crypto card provider Gnosis Pay says a breach of its legacy card system exposed customer data. Some notices list card numbers, home addresses and linked wallet addresses. It says no funds were taken.

author: cvedotnow
text: CRITICAL 9.8 Signal K Server: path traversal in resources API exposes JWT secret (CVE-2026-123807). Unauthenticated attackers can read server files, forge admin tokens, and run commands with server privileges. Fix: 2.34.0, 1.5.3

author: kkaasolutions
text: CVE-2026-123270 (CRITICAL / 9.8) Redpanda Connect versions 4.39 to 4.110 contain a missing authentication vulnerability that enables unauthenticated remote code execution.

author: kkaasolutions
text: CVE-2026-123800 (CRITICAL / 9.9) SuperTokens Core, an open source authentication server, critical vulnerability across 6.x-9.x branches.

author: dailycve
text: isomorphic-git, Directory Symlink Arbitrary File Write, CVE-2026-63395 (Critical)

author: Rachidmarcil
text: CISA adds IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218 to KEV, actively exploited. CVSS 9.8 incorrect-authorization flaw lets a user bypass checks and gain full admin privileges. Affects 5.0.0-5.0.19; fixed in 5.0.19 PL1.

author: FortressInfoSec
text: CISA added WordPress flaw CVE-2026-119977 to its KEV catalog. Attackers can exploit the update window to run code.

author: agentprime_io
text: IBM Aspera Faspex Authorization Bypass (CVE-2026-123218). Actively exploited. No fix listed yet.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: revoking a stolen GitHub token first can wipe your home folder, Socket says of a Ruby gem. strutil-core 1.0.1 poisons AI tool configs; a monitor checks the token every 45s; no confirmed victims. Socket: isolate, remove monitor, then revoke.

author: _pksharma
text: 27 Oct: an attacker exploits a flaw in Mittwald's MCP server, five minutes after registering an account. 4 Nov: Mittwald blocks the first attacker account, nearly 8 days later.

author: IntCyberDigest
text: The IP Microsoft tied to an AI agent that hunts leaked secrets on GitHub has new methods: VulnCheck's decoy servers caught it breaking into Langflow, IBM's tool for building AI agents, using CVE-2025-3248 (on CISA KEV since May 2025).

author: MonThreat
text: Forever Security found that Claude Dispatch, built to send tasks from your phone to Claude Desktop, also accepted commands from an ordinary browser session; a single browser extension on that page could drive the user's AI agent.

author: Huntbackio
text: One exposed server: an exploitation line, AI agents with standing orders, and a Telegram drug platform. Huntback recovered the workspace of crew SOUL SOCIETY from 146.19.213[.]192: a Go scanner feeding a Python exploit panel driven by AI agents.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: Malbear Labs 'Operation Snowball' (8 Nov): recovered the entire workspace of an autonomous AI intrusion harness mid-campaign; the operator sent 'go on' and the agent ran the intrusion for two weeks.

author: CCBalert
text: Actively exploited CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS 7.5) affects SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN. Attackers with valid alternate-method credentials may bypass SAML authentication and MFA.

author: 0daywatch
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-114625: on-prem, any logged-in user, even read-only, can gain operator-level access. Arista says it's actively exploited, and CISA lists it.

author: safebreach
text: Node2Shell isn’t just a http://Node.js problem. It’s a dependency problem. CVE-2026-111497 affects Brotli decoders across multiple platforms and is actively exploited. Locate embedded copies, patch, rebuild, and validate your defenses: https://t.co/aW1GgD1hcY https://t.co/UYJmqCJ3xI
